# The base branch moves on the remote while a round item runs. The agent step and the later command step run in the worktree at the tip that the engine made it at, before the first step.
# Nothing moves the worktree between steps.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C origin checkout -q main
exec git -C origin rev-parse integration/r1
cp stdout base-tip

fixture project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
# The script tests the round, not the sandbox, so its project keeps the sandbox off, though the fixture project file sets it on.
replace config/projects/local.star 'sandbox = "on"' 'sandbox = "off"'
subst flow/round.star
subst fake/claude
chmod 755 fake/claude

exec beehestreal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
exec beehestreal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
stdout 'item round/integration/r1 finished'

# The base moved after the first step, and no later step followed it.
exec git -C origin rev-parse integration/r1
! cmp stdout base-tip
cmp first.head base-tip
cmp agent.head base-tip
cmp last.head base-tip

-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- origin/MOVED_MARKER --
moved
-- flow/round.star --
def main(item):
    command(name = "first", run = ["sh", "-c", "git rev-parse HEAD > @WORK@/first.head; git -C @WORK@/origin checkout -q integration/r1; git -C @WORK@/origin add MOVED_MARKER; git -C @WORK@/origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m moved; git -C @WORK@/origin checkout -q main"])
    agent(name = "probe", prompt = "prompts/probe.md", model = "m")
    command(name = "last", run = ["sh", "-c", "git rev-parse HEAD > @WORK@/last.head"])
-- flow/prompts/probe.md --
Probe the folder.
-- fake/claude --
#!/bin/sh
cat > /dev/null
git rev-parse HEAD > "@WORK@/agent.head"
echo '{"type":"result","session_id":"s1","result":"done"}'
